episodes.synopsis: Aki arrives in Tokyo ready to make a fresh start. The first step is finding his dorm Sunohara House and meeting the residents of his new home.
episodes.title: Spring Breeze, Going to Tokyo, Miss Caretaker

episodes.synopsis: Aki and Ayaka work on getting more in sync, Aki gets Ayaka's input on a new look, and the residents of Sunohara House learn about each other's fears.
episodes.title: Special Training, Snip Snip, Fears

episodes.synopsis: Aki gets to know the President a little better, Sumire decides to make Aki a target of observation, and Yuri secures Aki's help with a project.
episodes.title: Elders, Getting Changed, Being a Man

episodes.synopsis: The residents of Sunohara House discuss their ideal marriage, Aki and Ayaka fix leaks in the roof, and Ayaka takes care of her residents after they get caught in the rain.
episodes.title: Start of the Rainy Season, Marriage, Lap Pillow

episodes.synopsis: Aki gets a taste of summer, Yuri gives Aki a lesson in photography, and Ayaka and Aki have a special day together.
episodes.title: Melons, Teacher, Drunk

episodes.synopsis: A former resident of Sunohara House returns for a visit, Aki gets to know her better, and everyone goes to the public pool.
episodes.title: High School Girl, Swimsuits, Summer Break

episodes.synopsis: Aki gets spooked, Yuri passes on her secret technique, and Nana helps her friends finish their homework.
episodes.title: Ghosts, Homework, Massage

episodes.synopsis: Aki learns about one of Ayaka's special skills, the residents of Sunohara House go to a festival, and Aki finds himself separated from the group.
episodes.title: Ear Cleaning, Lost, Fireworks

episodes.synopsis: Aki and Ayaka help Ms. Yatsuho, Nana comes to visit, and Aki takes care of Ayaka.
episodes.title: Roasted Sweet Potato, Nursing, Mascot

episodes.synopsis: Aki runs into Nana and her crew, Ayaka takes Aki on a special outing, and the other residents ask Aki what it's like to have siblings.
episodes.title: Costumes, Penguins, Playing Big Sister

episodes.synopsis: Aki's sister Matsuri arrives at Sunohara House, Ayaka undergoes a test, and Matsuri bonds with Aki.
episodes.title: Assault, Super Sweet, Hospitality

episodes.synopsis: Aki and Ayaka stay warm under the kotatsu, Christmas comes to Sunohara House, and the residents welcome the new year together.
episodes.title: Kotatsu, Year End, Santa
